title: PCFL Transition-Path P0/P1 preflight for compiled-text causal action use
summary: Supersede J/P plus Bubblewrap as the paper-ROI prerequisite with a narrow PCFL-specific transition-path preflight: deterministic CPU construct/shortcut/visibility/resource certification, then—only after exact human ratification, P0 all-pass, and fresh independent code review—one six-pair target-blind mechanically compiled-text action canary. The transition tree is not the sole paper benchmark; no LoRA, training, full confirmation, claim release, automatic successor, lease change, unrelated edit, or unrelated networking is authorized.
system_thesis: The project ultimately asks whether agents become better with longer lives, but this successor tests only a prerequisite causal arrow: whether a pinned resolver can turn public witnessed transition bindings, mechanically compiled without targets, into correct later four-move action paths under dependent reverse retrieval. A pass justifies asking a human for a fresh paper-world design; it does not establish self-learning, connected-memory organization, autonomous dreaming, parametric transport, compression, lifetime scaling, baseline saturation, on-policy improvement, generic SOTA superiority, or a paper result.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mechanically verify that each node contributes one independent binding bit and that allocated/introduced/supported/compiled/readable/usable counts are distinct. This preflight has only M0/M1 and no native-context checkpoints or scaling surface.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every counted binding is a unique causal bit; repeated events count zero new information; no native-context, lifetime-curve, scaling, or plateau claim is represented or authorized.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Token/event growth is mislabeled knowledge growth or the preflight is silently promoted into the rejected scale design.

acceptance_tests.setup: Certify D1/D4 unique shortest paths, exact target-only priors, four dependent reverse reads, four executed moves and commit, H/tau directional replay, lag, complete old/new/both cuts, and matched shams before model output.
acceptance_tests.expected: Typed exact-graph and flat-bag controllers score one itemwise on supported cells; decisive cuts break paths while shams do not; P1 credit uses executed trajectories and directional effects, not citations or action change alone.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Depth is decorative, caps are insufficient, target priors solve the task, memory cuts are incomplete, or a plan/QA answer substitutes for action.

acceptance_tests.setup: Bind target-only, exact public graph, authentic linked text, flat atom-bag scan, crossed-twin, lagged, decisive-cut, and sham controls to the same side-life public corpus and targets. LoRA and paper baselines are absent.
acceptance_tests.expected: P1 can attribute only mechanically compiled-text semantic use through the measured reader; bag/graph outcomes explicitly block connected-memory rhetoric and every assigned corpus/failure remains.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The canary credits index/search cognition to learned memory, filters useful corpora, or implies a LoRA/baseline result not run.

acceptance_tests.setup: Count every corpus/index/bag/graph/cache/prompt byte, scan comparison, call, token, latency, CPU operation, action, and failure for the finite canary; statically verify zero capacity grid, LoRA, confirmation, plateau, compression, or asymptotic query claim.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only observed-range resource receipts are produced; index intelligence is counted; all response-surface and saturation language is unavailable.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A fixed index, small sample, or omitted external state is used to claim scaling, efficiency, parametric recall, compression, or baseline plateau.

acceptance_tests.setup: Freeze 32 P0 and six disjoint P1 pair roots, nested-unit semantics, 114 assignments, raw/normalized values, exact integer thresholds, strict zeros, environment-wide NOT_RUN, caps, and terminal outputs before any model call.
acceptance_tests.expected: No P0/P1 root overlap, pseudoreplication, exclusion, optional stopping, threshold repair, corpus selection, or automatic dispatch; six P1 pairs remain calibration only.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Outcomes select targets/corpora/cells, missingness improves results, or a technical pass promotes a successor/claim.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh nonauthor reproduces P0 and reviews frozen code/manifests before P1; any later evidence review receives raw failure-inclusive artifacts and maps them to exact internal sentences with APPROVE_NARROW, NULL, NOT_RUN, or REJECT.
acceptance_tests.expected: Review preserves rejection, non-overriding advocacy, fresh review after repair, and zero execution/successor/promotion/claim authority from any verdict.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Approval is forced, evidence is incomplete, advocacy overrides rejection, or review is treated as authority.

acceptance_tests.setup: Generate topology/IDs/age/source order/targets/cuts before bits, seal the manifest before source events, then execute the propensity-one 240-slot target-unaware deck without branch or retry.
acceptance_tests.expected: Targets are total and independent of bits/support/compiler outcomes; H/tau reuse shape/order/action slots; all coverage denominators and failures persist.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Source or target selection conditions on realized truth, support, compilation, or prior results.

acceptance_tests.setup: Apply the bound descendant table and inject forbidden sentinels through value/hash/filename/order/rank/count/omission/length/retry/error/timing/cache/RNG/conversation/index/workspace/resource channels; reverse execution order across side/goal/arm/split.
acceptance_tests.expected: Zero forbidden tag reaches compiler/model-bound bytes; each guard-removal mutant fails; constant shapes and complete fresh-object resets hold.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A target, truth, arm, result, metadata, cache, or carryover descendant can steer cognition or compilation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Enumerate all lower-depth paths and decisive-bit orbits; prove exact D1/D4 Bayes headroom, dependent reverse/forward atom identity, exact-graph and no-link bag controller value one, and complete binding cuts with endpoints/topology held fixed.
acceptance_tests.expected: Depth is unique and itemwise solvable under caps; cuts are necessary; graph/bag controls prevent learned-link credit regardless of result.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A shorter route, target shortcut, uncapped lookup, endpoint change, or link-free control invalidates the intended interpretation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Compile every P1 H/tau M0/M1 prefix before target release and run every preassigned text/null/control episode without per-life usefulness filtering; apply one aggregate rule only after all outcomes freeze.
acceptance_tests.expected: The text canary is disjoint, target-blind, failure-inclusive, nonconfirmatory, and terminal; a positive only requests fresh human design.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Useful corpora are selected, failed lives disappear, code is repaired from canary outcomes, or LoRA/confirmation dispatch follows.

acceptance_tests.setup: Statically and dynamically verify zero adapter/trainer/gradient/LoRA object or call in P0/P1; measure linked versus bag reader state/work; bind the complete candidate-only/wrong-twin/unaided/authentic-twin/decisive-sham paired-training requirements as mandatory for any future fresh LoRA proposal.
acceptance_tests.expected: Current evidence cannot support parametric or LoRA credit; no reader result is misattributed to weights; reintroduction requires a new material change and authority.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A hidden adapter/training path exists or the canary is used as LoRA/substrate evidence.

acceptance_tests.setup: Verify disjoint whole-pair roots, six fixed canary pairs, side/goal/arm nesting, exact values and integer gate, no inferential interval, one frozen generator, and conservative zero/NOT_RUN semantics.
acceptance_tests.expected: P1 is explicitly unpowered calibration with no population, robustness, lifetime, baseline, or paper inference; nested observations never inflate n.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Six pairs are described as confirmation/power, target-level n, or generator-general evidence.

acceptance_tests.setup: Validate exact P0->fresh-review->P1 ordering, future write allowlist, 32/6 roots, 114 P1 episodes, 474 response/360 read/570 action caps, token/memory/disk/time limits, failure ledger, and zero-resource forbidden rows.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only feasible P0/P1 work can run; any overrun or extra cell stops; no full Cartesian, confirmation, or automatic stage exists.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Scope, resources, cells, or calendar can expand after outcomes or outside ratification.

acceptance_tests.setup: Provide exact reproduction, raw failures/resources, internal C0-C5 sentences, and authority files to a fresh reviewer without author conclusions; require one explicit four-way verdict and new review after any repair.
acceptance_tests.expected: Any verdict is valid and nonauthorizing; no paper/benchmark/scientific claim is released; the advocate cannot override rejection.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Review is biased toward approval, repaired evidence retains stale approval, or a verdict releases a claim/successor.
